hero.greeting: Hi, I'm a full-stack developer, Zhou Shuo.
hero.subline: I focus on building clean, usable, and interesting digital products. Here is my portfolio and open source work.
hero.tip: Experienced in AI development, App, Web, and server-side development. Capable of handling the full workflow from product design, marketing, and software development to app store publishing. Have independently led multiple projects.

skills.title: Marketing
skills.body: I believe marketing is the most important part of any work. Being familiar with mainstream domestic and international marketing methods is one of my strengths.

skills.title: Communication
skills.body: I firmly believe in the importance of communication in collaboration, and strive to be a developer who guides teamwork in a transparent and flexible way. I often serve as a bridge between designers and developers, clearly expressing both sides' ideas and proposing compromises.

skills.title: Code
skills.body: I focus on writing clear, intuitive code so that other developers can easily read and maintain it. I value naming conventions, responsibility-based structural design, and excel at building scalable component systems to effectively improve the team's overall code quality.

skills.title: Documentation
skills.body: I enjoy organizing key decisions, interface agreements, and usage methods into documentation to help teams reduce repetitive communication. I believe good documentation is as important as the product itself, enabling knowledge and experience to flow continuously.

projects.title: EteDrop: P2P File Transfer & Sharing System
projects.description: A P2P file transfer app built with Flutter and NestJS. Supports direct device-to-device transfer via WebRTC with no cloud storage, available on Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, and web.

projects.title: EasyNVR: Enterprise Video Edge Computing & Management Platform
projects.description: An enterprise video platform connecting IP cameras to web/mobile. Features browser-side H.265 decoding via WASM, 100+ concurrent live feeds, and protocol conversion (RTSP/ONVIF to WebRTC/HLS). Supports 2000+ channels.

projects.title: Yeezy: Online Store
projects.description: A Yeezy-style website featuring a fully functional shopping cart, PayPal and Apple Pay integration, an admin backend, and order fulfillment capabilities. The UI is clean and sophisticated.

repos.name: taobao-1688-image-scraper
repos.description: Bulk download product images from Taobao & 1688 with automatic background removal. Ideal for cross-border e-commerce migration.

repos.name: yeezy
repos.description: A minimalist e-commerce demo with Next.js, React 19, and SQLite. Includes storefront, admin panel, cart/checkout, and PayPal integration.

repos.name: SignUp_WeChat
repos.description: A WeChat mini-program for sports event registration. Supports sign-up, payment, ticket generation, results query, and admin management.
